label: Oštiepok
note: The PGI allows it steamed or not, smoked or not; Goral oscypek is a different cheese (different ratios and process). Egg-, cone- or ellipse-shaped with ornaments pressed in.

about.text: Oštiepok is a traditional smoked Slovak sheep milk cheese, protected under the EU PGI. It is shaped like a large egg or cone and decorated with patterns; milk is sheep, sheep plus cow, or cow.
